title: Dyeing at home safely: written guide
subject: Art & Design
source: Written for art/y8 lesson 16 (Written home safety guide: an adult supervises all dyeing and any heating; gloves; covered surfaces; ventilated room; follow the kit instructions; keep dyes away from food and young children (TO CONFIRM: parent superv...)
intro: Lesson 16. Read it all with the adult who will supervise before you start. Ask a parent to agree before any dyeing at home.

practical.aim: To dye two tied cloth samples safely at home and compare them with your predictions
equipment: A tie-dye kit or natural dye (turmeric, onion skins or red cabbage)
A plastic bowl and a plastic sheet
safety: An adult supervises all dyeing and any heating
Wear gloves; keep dye off skin
Cover surfaces with a plastic sheet
Keep dyes away from food and young children
method: Cover the table, put on old clothes and gloves; the adult is with you
Prepare the dye as the kit says (natural dye: the adult heats water with the turmeric, onion skins or cabbage and lets it cool)
Apply or dip the dye, with the adult supervising
Leave it for the time the guide says
Rinse in cold water until the water runs clear, then untie
Dry the samples and photograph them again
